integrity: Proof includes exact gambler-ruin transitions, explicit absolute-error coupling, and Bernoulli CLT. Finite exact checks are supporting evidence, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Nearest-neighbor cyclic walk with a constant probability within each cycle, frontier-discovery alternations only; absolute coupling constant not optimized. No local limit or cover-time law established.
title: Logarithmic frontier-switch universality for biased cycle walks
